name: Rajasthan
info: Rajasthan is known for its magnificent temples and rich cultural heritage.
story: The land of kings has numerous ancient temples that reflect its glorious past.
visiting_guide: Best visited between October and March. Carry water and wear comfortable footwear.
architecture: Rajasthani temples feature intricate marble carvings and shikhara towers.
mention_in_scripture: Various Puranas mention temples in this region.

temples.name: Brahma Temple Pushkar
temples.about: One of the very few temples dedicated to Lord Brahma, the creator god.

temples.name: Eklingji Temple
temples.about: Ancient temple complex dedicated to Lord Shiva, patron deity of the Mewar rulers.

temples.name: Dilwara Temples
temples.about: Famous Jain temples known for their extraordinary marble carvings.

name: Tamil Nadu
info: Tamil Nadu is home to some of the most magnificent Dravidian temples in India.
story: The land of temples has over 33,000 ancient temples, many built by the Chola, Pallava, and Pandya dynasties.
visiting_guide: Best visited between November and February. Dress modestly and remove footwear.
architecture: Dravidian architecture with towering gopurams (gateway towers) and mandapams.

temples.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
temples.about: Ancient Shiva temple in Mylapore, Chennai, known for its colorful gopuram.

temples.name: Nataraja Temple Chidambaram
temples.about: One of the Pancha Bhuta Stalas, representing the element of space (Akasha).

temples.name: Arunachaleswarar Temple
temples.about: One of the Pancha Bhuta Stalas, representing the element of fire (Agni).

temples.name: Murugan Temple Palani
temples.about: One of the six abodes of Lord Murugan, located on a hill.

name: Uttar Pradesh
info: Uttar Pradesh is the spiritual heartland of India with numerous sacred cities.
story: The state is home to Varanasi, Mathura, Ayodhya, and Prayagraj — four of the seven sacred cities.
visiting_guide: Best visited between October and March. Kumbh Mela is held every 12 years at Prayagraj.
architecture: Temples range from ancient stone structures to ornate marble edifices.

temples.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
temples.about: One of the most famous Hindu temples, one of the 12 Jyotirlingas.

temples.name: Banke Bihari Temple
temples.about: One of the most famous Krishna temples in Vrindavan.

temples.name: Vindhyavasini Temple
temples.about: Important Shakti Peetha dedicated to Goddess Vindhyavasini.

name: Karnataka
info: Karnataka has a rich tradition of temple architecture spanning multiple dynasties.
story: The Hoysala, Chalukya, and Vijayanagara empires built magnificent temples across Karnataka.
visiting_guide: Best visited between October and February. Hampi and Belur are must-visit sites.
architecture: Hoysala, Chalukya, and Vijayanagara architectural styles are prominent.

temples.name: Virupaksha Temple Hampi
temples.about: UNESCO World Heritage Site, one of the oldest functioning temples in India.

temples.name: Hoysaleswara Temple Halebidu
temples.about: 12th-century Hoysala temple known for its intricate sculptures.

temples.name: Chamundeshwari Temple
temples.about: Temple dedicated to Goddess Chamundeshwari on Chamundi Hills overlooking Mysuru.

temples.name: Dharmasthala Temple
temples.about: Famous pilgrimage center managed by the Heggade family, known for free meals.

name: Odisha
info: Odisha is famous for the Jagannath Temple and its unique temple architecture.
story: The Kalinga style of temple architecture reached its zenith in Odisha.
visiting_guide: Best visited between October and March. Rath Yatra in June/July is spectacular.
architecture: Kalinga architecture with deul (tower) and jagamohana (porch) are distinctive.

temples.name: Jagannath Temple Puri
temples.about: One of the Char Dham pilgrimage sites, famous for the annual Rath Yatra.
temples.festivals: Rath Yatra, Snana Purnima, Chandan Yatra

temples.name: Lingaraj Temple
temples.about: The largest temple in Bhubaneswar, a masterpiece of Kalinga architecture.

name: Gujarat
info: Gujarat has a rich tradition of temple architecture and pilgrimage sites.
story: The state is home to several Jyotirlingas and important Shakti Peethas.
visiting_guide: Best visited between October and March. Somnath and Dwarka are must-visit.
architecture: Solanki and Maru-Gurjara architectural styles are prominent.

temples.name: Ambaji Temple
temples.about: One of the 51 Shakti Peethas, an important pilgrimage site in Gujarat.

temples.name: Akshardham Temple Gandhinagar
temples.about: Beautiful temple complex dedicated to Lord Swaminarayan, built by BAPS.

name: Maharashtra
info: Maharashtra has numerous important pilgrimage sites and ancient temples.
story: The state is home to several Jyotirlingas, Ashtavinayak temples, and Shakti Peethas.
visiting_guide: Best visited between October and February. Avoid monsoon season for hill temples.
architecture: Hemadpanthi style of architecture is common in Maharashtra temples.

temples.name: Pandharpur Vitthal Temple
temples.about: One of the most important pilgrimage sites in Maharashtra, visited during Wari.

temples.name: Bhimashankar Temple
temples.about: One of the 12 Jyotirlingas, located in the Sahyadri mountains.

temples.name: Tuljapur Bhavani Temple
temples.about: One of the three and a half Shakti Peethas in Maharashtra.

name: Kerala
info: Kerala has a unique tradition of temple architecture and rituals.
story: Kerala temples are known for their distinctive Kerala style architecture and elaborate rituals.
visiting_guide: Best visited between October and March. Dress code is strictly enforced.
architecture: Kerala style with sloping roofs, wooden carvings, and copper-covered towers.

temples.name: Sabarimala Temple
temples.about: One of the most visited pilgrimage sites in the world, open during Mandalam season.
temples.darshan_timings: Open during Mandalam, Makaravilakku, and Vishu seasons

temples.name: Attukal Bhagavathy Temple
temples.about: Known as the Sabarimala of women, hosts the world's largest gathering of women.
